title: I built a small game in 2.5 days with AI, and you can play it right now, completely free.
author: Heavy_Extent_3863
selftext:
Glorb 9B: Director's Cut is my entry for the **2026 Epic AI MegaJam**. You play Glorbi, an alien janitor at a busy spaceport: scoop up wobbly goo, throw it into the bin from way too far away, and vacuum up mysterious puddles, while an over-excited film director comments on your every move. Why does everything feel so... cinematic? Play to the end and find out.

How it was made:

\- One human (me: game design and direction) and one AI agent (Claude Code) driving Unreal Engine 5.9

\- All 2D art with ChatGPT Images; voices, sound effects and music with ElevenLabs; 3D models with Meshy

\- None of it existed before November 12

A small side story: NVIDIA's DLSS 4.5 plugin isn't out for UE 5.9 yet, so we rebuilt it from source. It took ten tiny fixes. As far as I know, that makes this the first released UE 5.9 game with DLSS 4.5.

I wrote everything down in a dev log: how the work was split between me and the agent, what the agent built, and everything that went wrong along the way, including a bug that every automated test missed and only showed up when a real key was pressed.

Dev log: [https://ohmplex.itch.io/glorb-9b/devlog/1781110/how-glorb-9b-was-built-in-25-days-one-human-one-ai-agent](https://ohmplex.itch.io/glorb-9b/devlog/1781110/how-glorb-9b-was-built-in-25-days-one-human-one-ai-agent)

Play free (Windows): [https://ohmplex.itch.io/glorb-9b](https://ohmplex.itch.io/glorb-9b)

Feedback is very welcome.
